# spnego — SPNEGO (HTTP Negotiate)

[All groups](README.md)

## spnego http

Test Kerberos single sign-on to a web resource (SPNEGO, RFC 4559): check the server offers Negotiate (and whether it also offers NTLM), get a ticket for HTTP/host, send it, and report the result and any mutual-authentication token.

MCP tool: `spnego_http`.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--url` | string | Protected URL. **Required.** |
| `--spn` | string | Service principal; default HTTP/&lt;host&gt;. |
| `--principal` | string | Client principal, user or user@REALM. |
| `--realm` | string | Realm, if not in principal. |
| `--kdc` | list | KDC host[:port] list; default from krb5_conf or DNS SRV records. |
| `--krb5-conf` | string | krb5.conf to use instead of kdc/etypes (a path from the CLI or a profile). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--password` | string | Password (prefer env IDPDBG_PASSWORD or a profile). Secret: falls back to `IDPDBG_PASSWORD`, redacted in traces. |
| `--keytab` | string | Client keytab instead of a password (a path, or base64). May be a file path (CLI or profile only). |
| `--etypes` | list | Encryption types to request. Default `aes256-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes128-cts-hmac-sha1-96,aes256-cts-hmac-sha384-192,aes128-cts-hmac-sha256-128`. |

Plus the [common parameters](README.md#common-parameters).
